dedupe_keys.name: europe road network extracted from openstreetmap data

description: Bashini Mahaarachchi publishes a frozen European road-line extract derived from OpenStreetMap. Zenodo supplies CSV and Parquet tables, with a preview map, as free public downloads. The source extraction date is written as 04/07/2020; its day-month interpretation should be checked. The selection contains motorway, trunk, primary, secondary, tertiary, unclassified and residential highway tags as line strings in WGS84 coordinates. These geometries can prepare network extents or spatial exposure inputs for road simulations. Related catalogue record data-openstreetmap describes the upstream database. Zenodo labels this derivative CC BY 4.0, while the parent database has separate ODbL terms; downstream rights were not reconciled here. The extract does not establish junction connectivity, traffic volumes or link capacities. Coverage excludes road classes outside the stated filter, and positional and temporal completeness remain uncertain. No table was downloaded or topology built.
